nodes.name: Rules – Validate balances and create keys

parameters.content:
Every transaction gets a fingerprint (the key), so the database can recognise it if the same statement is uploaded again.

Before: the fingerprint included the tidy name Claude chose, e.g. "Disney+". But Claude doesn't always choose the same name; once it wrote "Disney Plus." Same transaction, different fingerprint, so it could be saved twice.
Now: the fingerprint uses the exact text printed on the bank statement, e.g. "Disney Plus." That text never changes, so the same transaction always gets the same fingerprint.
